name: Pascagoula Supply Line

values.Owner: Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company LLC; Florida Gas Transmission Co LLC
values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)

researcher_notes: Not in the GEM roster under any name. P2627 (Florida Gas Transmission Mobile Bay Lateral Expansion, 8.9 mi) is a different, separate 8.8 mi project from the same filing pair. A 2009 Williams Partners and FGT press release says the jointly developed Pascagoula Expansion Project is about 15.54 miles of 26-inch pipe (4.59 mi in Mobile County, Alabama and 10.95 mi in Jackson County, Mississippi), $59 million, about 810,000 dekatherms per day, joining the Gulf LNG terminal at Bayou Casotte to the Mobile Bay Lateral. FERC lists it as docket CP09-456 at 15.50 mi and 810 million cubic feet per day. The EIA August 2026 workbook (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 699, project 'Pascagoula Expansion Project', segment 'Pascagoula Supply Line') lists it as Completed, in service 2011, 15.5 mi, 26 in. All sources trace to the same applicants, so they are not fully independent. Length 15.54 mi is about 25.01 km, so it clears the 25 km rule by a hair; the FERC and EIA figure of 15.5 mi would be just under. Owner split between the two companies is not stated in these sources, so no percentages are given. Federal Register notice of September 3, 2009 (E9-21247) confirms the application and 26-inch pipe but gives only a rounded 15 miles, so it is not cited for length. Route not researched; no official GIS found.
